requirement.normalizedRequirement: For bow forms defined in I2.3.1(v), take f_ai = min(f_ai1, f_ai2, f_ai3), where f_ai1 = (0.097 - 0.68*(x/L_UI - 0.15)^2)*alpha_i/(beta_i_prime)^0.5, f_ai2 = 1.2*C_FF/(sin(beta_i_prime)*C_FC*D_UI^0.64), and f_ai3 = 0.60.
requirement.source: UR I2 Structural Requirements for Polar Class Ships
requirement.sourceText: For bow forms defined in I2.3.1(v), the shape coefficient f_ai is to be taken as f_ai = minimum(f_ai1, f_ai2, f_ai3), where f_ai1 = (0.097 - 0.68*(x/L_UI - 0.15)^2)*alpha_i/(beta_i_prime)^0.5, f_ai2 = 1.2*C_FF/(sin(beta_i_prime)*C_FC*D_UI^0.64), and f_ai3 = 0.60.
